[
  {
    "i": 0,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.07, "unit": "%", "anchor": "2Py ETL enables an efficiency of 26.07% for inverted PSCs based on a 1.55‐eV bandgap."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Wide-bandgap (1.80 eV) and narrow-bandgap (1.25 eV) inverted PSCs with the 2Py ETL reach 19.94% and 24.06% efficiencies.", "anchor": "Wide‐bandgap (1.80 eV) and narrow‐bandgap (1.25 eV) PSCs achieve efficiencies of 19.94% and 24.06%, respectively.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The 2Py-based devices show T99 >1080 h at 85°C heating and T99 >1250 h under MPPT at 45°C.", "anchor": "Notably, these devices demonstrate exceptional photo‐thermal stability, achieving T 99 >1080 h under 85°C heating and T 99 >1250 h under maximum power point tracking at 45°C, outperforming PCBM‐based devices.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 1,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.23, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Specifically, featuring optimized energy level alignment and superior surface wettability, oxetane-functionalized ETL endowed n-i-p structured PSCs with a champion power conversion efficiency of 25.23%, among the highest values reported for organic ETL-based devices."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Thermo-crosslinking organic ETMs were designed by adding heat-inducible triallyl or oxetane cross-linking groups to a naphthalene diimide scaffold.", "anchor": "Novel organic electron transport materials (ETMs) have been successfully designed by strategically incorporating heat-inducible cross-linking triallyl or oxetane functional groups into naphthalene diimide-based conjugation scaffold, respectively.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Ultrasonic testing and accelerated aging under 85°C and 65% RH were used to decode improved interfacial robustness and stability.", "anchor": "Non-destructive ultrasonic testing and accelerated aging assessments have been explored for the first time to decode the substantial improvements in interfacial robustness and operational stability under thermal (85°C) and humid conditions (65% relative humidity).", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 2,
    "architecture": "tandem_2T",
    "absorber": "wide-bandgap perovskite (1.77 eV)",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 29.35, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Using these high‐performance WBG subcells, we fabricated all‐perovskite tandem devices that deliver maximum power conversion efficiencies of 29.35% (certified 28.98%) on 0.05 cm 2 and 28.83% (certified 28.49%) on 1 cm 2 devices."},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 28.98, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Using these high‐performance WBG subcells, we fabricated all‐perovskite tandem devices that deliver maximum power conversion efficiencies of 29.35% (certified 28.98%) on 0.05 cm 2 and 28.83% (certified 28.49%) on 1 cm 2 devices."},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 0.05, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "Using these high‐performance WBG subcells, we fabricated all‐perovskite tandem devices that deliver maximum power conversion efficiencies of 29.35% (certified 28.98%) on 0.05 cm 2 and 28.83% (certified 28.49%) on 1 cm 2 devices."},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "The Br-4PhCz SAM hole-transport layer gives wide-bandgap PSCs an open-circuit voltage of 1.36 V at a 1.77 eV bandgap.", "anchor": "By integrating Br‐4PhCz, we obtained an impressive open‐circuit voltage of 1.36 V in WBG PSCs with a bandgap of 1.77 eV.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Br-4PhCz exhibits a large dipole moment, face-on orientation, uniform coverage, and superior self-assembly quality.", "anchor": "The resulting Br‐4PhCz exhibits a large dipole moment, adopts a face‐on molecular orientation with uniform substrate coverage, and demonstrates superior self‐assembly quality.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 3,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 23.14, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Devices treated with [12]‐C‐4POR delivered a champion PCE of 23.14%, surpassing the control device (21.6%), along with enhanced open‐circuit voltage (V OC ) and fill factor (FF)."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "[12]-C-4POR reduces trap-state density and suppresses non-radiative recombination in perovskite films.", "anchor": "The incorporation of [12]‐C‐4POR into perovskite films significantly reduced the trap‐state density and suppressed non‐radiative recombination, leading to improved charge‐carrier dynamics.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Passivated devices retain about 95% of initial PCE after 800 h of continuous operation versus about 55% for the control.", "anchor": "More importantly, the passivated devices retained ∼95% of their initial PCE after 800 h of continuous operation, compared to ∼55% for the control.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The dual-cavity macrocycle binds undercoordinated Pb2+ via the porphyrin core and Li+ via the crown ether unit.", "anchor": "Herein, we report a rationally designed meso ‐crowned porphyrin derivative ( [12]‐C‐4POR ) featuring dual macrocyclic binding sites, i.e., a porphyrin core for undercoordinated Pb 2+ and a crown ether unit selective for Li + to suppress surface defects and mitigate lithium‐ion migration simultaneously.", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 4,
    "architecture": "module",
    "absorber": "FAMA-based perovskite (1.7 eV)",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 13.78, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Consequently, the champion ST‐PSC delivers 13.78% power conversion efficiency (PCE), 31.1% average visible transmittance (AVT), and a high light utilization efficiency (LUE) of 4.29%."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "A 1.7 eV FAMA perovskite layer of about 185 nm with a MoO3/Au/MoO3 electrode giving 59.9% transmittance was designed via transfer matrix simulations.", "anchor": "Guided by transfer matrix simulations, a 1.7 eV FAMA‐based perovskite layer with a thickness of ∼185 nm was integrated with an optimized MoO 3 /Au/MoO 3 top electrode (59.9% transmittance).", "evidence_type": "simulation"},
      {"text": "The devices achieve 22.41% indoor PCE under 1000 lux LED and a 30 × 30 cm2 module retains 8.2% (7.4%) PCE under 1 sun (0.2 sun).", "anchor": "Notably, this study demonstrates for the first time efficient indoor operation of ST‐PSCs, achieving 22.41% indoor PCE (iPCE) under 1000 lux LED illumination, and further realizes the first scalable 30 × 30 cm 2 semi‐transparent module retaining 8.2% (7.4%) PCE under 1 sun (0.2 sun).", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Unencapsulated ST-PSCs retain 79.6% of initial PCE after 268 h of standard light soaking.", "anchor": "The unencapsulated ST‐PSCs retain 79.6% of initial PCE after 268 h of continuous standard light soaking.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 5,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "CsPbI3-xBrx",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 22.19, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Through these synergistic effects, the CsPbI 3‐x Br x device achieves a power conversion efficiency of 22.19%, among the highest reported for such materials, while retaining over 90% of its initial efficiency after 800 h in ambient air."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "RAC-NFA operates via a stereoselective complementarity mechanism that inhibits halide vacancy formation and drives secondary crystal growth.", "anchor": "Theoretical and experimental analyses reveal that RAC-NFA operates via a “stereoselective complementarity” mechanism, which not only inhibits halide vacancy formation through “lock‐and‐key” coordination but also drives thermodynamically favorable secondary crystal growth and surface reconstruction, leading to larger, high‐quality grains.", "evidence_type": "simulation"},
      {"text": "Densely packed aromatic Fmoc groups at grain boundaries suppress phase transition and moisture/oxygen penetration.", "anchor": "Additionally, the densely packed aromatic Fmoc groups at grain boundaries effectively suppress phase transition and moisture/oxygen penetration.", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 6,
    "architecture": "tandem_2T",
    "absorber": "wide-bandgap perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 31.85, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Furthermore, when integrated into two‐terminal (2T) mechanically stacked and monolithic perovskite/silicon tandem architectures, the optimized devices achieved efficiencies of 31.85% and 30.17% with enhanced stability."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "PEACl modification combined with CB/DMSO mixed-solution etching removes residual PbI2 and suppresses the metastable 2D perovskite phase.", "anchor": "In this study, a surface phase regulation strategy is presented that combines PEACl modification with chlorobenzene (CB)/ dimethylsulfoxide (DMSO) mixed solution etching (CDSE) to precisely remove residual PbI 2 and suppress the metastable 2D perovskite phase.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Wide-bandgap PSCs reach 21.77% PCE and maintain 85% of initial efficiency after 1600 h in an inert atmosphere.", "anchor": "This synergistic mechanism substantially reduces interfacial trap states and carrier recombination, resulting in wide‐bandgap perovskite solar cells with a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 21.77% and excellent operational stability, maintaining 85% of the initial efficiency after 1600 h in an inert atmosphere.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 7,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": "inorganic perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 21.67, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Ultimately, the power conversion efficiency (PCE) of inverted inorganic perovskite solar cells (IPSCs) with CBSA is increased from 18.88% to 21.67%."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Unencapsulated devices maintain 95% of initial efficiency after 550 h of MPPT under continuous 1-sun illumination.", "anchor": "More importantly, unencapsulated devices maintained 95% of their initial efficiency after 550 h of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) under continuous 1‐sun illumination, demonstrating exceptional operational stability.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "CBSA locks iodide ions via hydrogen bonding, reducing iodine defects and passivating undercoordinated lead defects.", "anchor": "Moreover, CBSA locks iodide ions through hydrogen bonding to reduce the formation of iodine defects and iodine species, while reducing trap density and alleviating perovskite decomposition by passivating undercoordinated lead defects.", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 8,
    "architecture": "tandem_2T",
    "absorber": "wide-bandgap iodide-bromide perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 28.41, "unit": "%", "anchor": "This strategy markedly enhances operational stability without sacrificing efficiency and is successfully extended to monolithic all‐perovskite tandem cells, where Li─T maintains high efficiency of 28.41% while significantly improving device stability."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "The Li-T ion-blocking interlayer suppresses F- diffusion while preserving LiF benefits, giving a VOC of 1.284 V and 19.55% efficiency in WBG devices.", "anchor": "To address this issue, we introduce lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide (Li─T) as a selective ion‐blocking interlayer (i.e. ion‐fence), which suppresses F − diffusion while preserving the benefits of LiF, yielding a high V OC of 1.284 V and efficiency of 19.55%.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "LiF diffuses into the perovskite layer, where F- accelerates halide segregation and compromises photostability.", "anchor": "We found that LiF does not remain confined to the interface but diffuses into the perovskite layer, where F − accelerate halide segregation and compromise device photostability.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 9,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": "MA-free perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.29, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Consequently, MTBH‐incorporated devices achieve a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.29% (versus 23.62% for control) with a high fill factor (FF: 84.94%) and open‐circuit voltage ( V OC : 1.19 V)."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "MTBH treatment reduces perovskite residual stress to 18.0 MPa versus 60.1 MPa for the control.", "anchor": "These interactions regulate perovskite crystallization kinetics, inducing a “fast nucleation‐slow growth” mode that yields high‐quality films with reduced residual stress (18.0 MPa versus Control's 60.1 MPa) and suppressed grain‐boundary defects.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retain 93.76% PCE after 2000 h in ambient air and 98.0% after 470 h of MPPT.", "anchor": "The devices also exhibit exceptional stability, retaining 93.76% PCE after 2000 h in ambient air and 98.0% after 470 h of maximum power point tracking.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 10,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.6, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Consequently, WH13-based inverted PSCs achieve a champion PCE of 26.6% (certified 26.24%) with exceptional operational stability (>99%, ISOS-L-1 500 h), representing the highest efficiency reported to date for SM-HTM-based PSCs."},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 26.24, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Consequently, WH13-based inverted PSCs achieve a champion PCE of 26.6% (certified 26.24%) with exceptional operational stability (>99%, ISOS-L-1 500 h), representing the highest efficiency reported to date for SM-HTM-based PSCs."},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": "ISOS-L-1",
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "The WH13 spatially engineered small-molecule HTM enhances perovskite/HTM interfacial interactions, promotes crystallization, and facilitates hole extraction.", "anchor": "By spatially exposing the functional heterocyclic core to release its full potential, the tailored WH13 dramatically enhances the perovskite/HTM interfacial interactions, promotes crystallization, and facilitates hole extraction.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "WH13 devices retain over 99% efficiency after 500 h under ISOS-L-1.", "anchor": "Consequently, WH13-based inverted PSCs achieve a champion PCE of 26.6% (certified 26.24%) with exceptional operational stability (>99%, ISOS-L-1 500 h), representing the highest efficiency reported to date for SM-HTM-based PSCs.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 11,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 20, "unit": "%", "anchor": "The device prepared using DMAFo as an additive achieved the best device efficiency of 20%."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "The ionic liquid additive DMAFo was synthesized with dimethylamine as the fixed cation and formate (HCOO-) as the selected anion site.", "anchor": "After selecting dimethylamine (DMA) as the fixed cation and selecting the anion site (I − , Br − , Cl − , HCOO − ), an ionic liquid additive, DMAFo, was synthesized, achieving multiple functions such as energy level regulation, removal of residual PbI 2 at the buried interface, retarding crystallization through the intermediate phase DMAPbI (3−x) HCOO x , filling halide vacancy defects, and releasing residual stress.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Synergy of DMA+ and HCOO- simultaneously addresses bulk and interface defects in the perovskite film.", "anchor": "Under the synergistic effect of DMA + and HCOO − , both bulk defects and interface defects in the perovskite film were simultaneously addressed.", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]
  }
]
